title: Wrong tile preview when trying to fix missing preview
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in: 4.6.1, 4.6

### System information

Godot v4.6.1.stable - Ubuntu 24.04.4 LTS 24.04 on X11 - X11 display driver, Multi-window, 2 monitors - OpenGL 3 (Compatibility) - AMD Radeon 760M Graphics (radeonsi, phoenix, LLVM 20.1.2, DRM 3.57, 6.8.0-100-generic) - AMD Ryzen 5 7640U w/ Radeon 760M Graphics (12 threads) - 13.45 GiB memory

### Issue description

When trying to fix missing tile previews after copying a project (https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/116441), every scene used as tile has to opened and re-saved (no changes needed). However, it has to be done while the (2D) workspace is active, otherwise the preview will be the last scene that was shown in the workspace.

### Steps to reproduce

- Make the tiles missing as in https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/116441
- Open the script editor, then open the tile scene and save
- Tile preview is now the last scene that was open in the 2D workspace
- Open the 2D workspace, then open the tile scene and save again
- Tile preview is correct now

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[wrong-tile-preview.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/25398367/wrong-tile-preview.zip)

Basically same as in https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/116441, just added a `TextureRect` and `ColorRect` so you can see something.
